app.name: Shinku 神紅 Editor
app.description: A modern, lightweight text editor built with Tauri and Rust
app.author: Alaa
about: Shinku (深紅) - meaning 'crimson' or 'deep red' in Japanese.
A modern, high-performance text editor built from the ground up with:
• Rust backend for blazing-fast file operations
• React + CodeMirror for smooth editing experience
• Ropey text buffer for efficient text manipulation
From the ashes of complexity, rises simplicity.
